propositions: Pass 1 must discover grounded candidate findings only and never assess validity, impact, severity, confidence, drop/block posture, or remediation instructions
Pass 2 must independently answer atomic validity and impact questions only and never discover new findings, decide outcomes, or prescribe fixes
Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds and partition findings without an LLM and never gather new evidence or coach
Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive next-move guidance for already-surfaced findings and never re-verify, alter decisions, or dictate exact implementations

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1 through RP-F6 must fire; RP-N1 through RP-N6 must not fire) must achieve recall 1.0, false-accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, minimum per-case stability at least 2/3, and Cohen kappa at least 0.70 across three live runs

The project criterion is entirely project-owned via committed .rebar/ prompt/routing/eval assets with proper guards, single-turn execution mode, grounded evidence output, absent severity/confidence fields, and empty suggested_fix
